name: Vendor Renewal Tracker
summary: Tracks vendor renewal dates and displays them in a sorted table.

items.title: Vendor renewal database
items.description: Stores each vendor's name and renewal date so the list can be kept up to date.
items.proved_when: Vendor renewal records can be saved, retrieved, and updated.
items.source_quote: Keep a list of our vendors with their renewal dates

items.title: Sorted vendor renewal table
items.description: Shows vendors in a table ordered by the nearest renewal date.
items.proved_when: The table lists vendors with the earliest renewal date at the top.
items.source_quote: show them in a table sorted by the next renewal

items.title: Initial vendor import
items.description: Loads vendor names and renewal dates from a file into the system.
items.proved_when: After importing a CSV, the vendor table shows the imported rows.
items.source_quote: Keep a list of our vendors with their renewal dates
